name: Eliana Flores
source:
Eliana is a marine biologist and one of Your Character's love interests. She is first seen in Chapter 1.

Eliana can be described as confident, nice, and flirty. She is persistent and driven because of her passion for the well-being of turtles, as well as, according to her, patient (most of the time). During the premium scene in Chapter 1, she tells you her father instilled her love of exploring by teaching her about different types of fauna. He is also the reason she loves marine biology.

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Eliana_Flores]Wiki[/url]]
